summary: Executed backend pytest and frontend Playwright against external preview URL. Core devnet foundation works; found one backend cookie-policy mismatch and one reproducible frontend navigation issue after dialog close.

critical.issue: Session cookie observed as 'SameSite=None; Partitioned' on external HTTPS response, while strict session isolation is expected in current implementation/testing criteria.

ui_bugs.issue: After opening then closing X dialog (Escape), immediate click on Dashboard link sometimes does not navigate and stays on home.

action_items: Investigate why Set-Cookie attributes are rewritten to SameSite=None/Partitioned on public endpoint for /api/wallet/verify.
Fix home dialog close -> dashboard click race/overlay absorption so navigation consistently transitions to /dashboard.
Retest wallet auth cookie policy and nav-dashboard interaction after fix.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest currently 17 passed / 1 failed. Single failing assertion is SameSite cookie policy on /wallet/verify. Frontend reproduced nav-dashboard non-navigation when click occurs right after closing X dialog. Mobile + desktop overflow checks passed on tested pages.
rca of the issue: RCA1 (backend cookie): server code sets SameSite strict, but externally observed response carries SameSite=None; Partitioned, indicating edge/proxy or response rewriting in deployed path. Repro: wallet challenge+verify using generated keypair signature; inspect Set-Cookie header. RCA2 (frontend nav): closing login dialog and clicking dashboard within ~100ms can leave URL at '/', suggesting close animation/overlay focus interception race. Repro: open [data-testid=nav-login], Escape, immediate click [data-testid=nav-dashboard].
